display_long_description:
Step into the future with Katana, the fundamental XR app designed for visionaries who want to shape, explore, and create in the metaverse. Whether you're a technical professional, a content creator, or simply someone curious about crafting your own digital reality, Katana empowers you to bring your work, life, and entertainment into augmented and virtual reality environments.

Katana XR augments your reality without hours of training and setup. On the Katana Pro web application users can author procedures, create checklists, build demos and write training for use in XR. Share your content with others, track progress and download analytics. 

Key Features:

- No-code authoring: Create content and publish to XR without coding skills from the Katana Pro web app.
- Multiple Choice Authoring and Display: Make your content interactive with multiple choice steps. Choices made by users in XR are logged and accessible via Katana Pro.
- Capture Inputs: Prompt XR users to enter information with input steps and capture their responses for review.
- Collaboration: Invite colleagues or clients to author content, or access your content in XR.
- Analytics: Track usage and responses from the Katana Pro web app and download PDF reports.

Sign up for free at katanaxr.com/register to start creating your own XR content.
